# ELDEN RING: NIGHTTIDE

### 艾尔登法环：黑夜入侵

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Installation](INSTALL.md) · [Known issues](KNOWN_ISSUES.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Credits](CREDITS.md)

NIGHTTIDE is an experimental Elden Ring overhaul with progression and balance changes, reworked encounters, and selected Nightreign boss integrations.

**Current build: v0.10.26 Public Beta 1 (`v0.10.26-beta.1`).** Download the complete player ZIP from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TrasAsimov/ELDEN-RING-NIGHTTIDE/releases). GitHub's automatically generated “Source code” archives contain documentation, not the playable mod.

This beta consolidates the F4 development build into one player package. It removes obsolete test reports and audit files, standardizes the launcher/profile names, and regenerates file checksums. **It adds no new gameplay fixes.** Dreglord's critical attack, Adel's grab attachment, Libra's combat behavior, and several visual/audio problems remain unresolved; read [the issue list](KNOWN_ISSUES.md) before installing.

## Install

Use Elden Ring with Shadow of the Erdtree and a separately installed ME3. The development baseline targets game version 1.17.1; compatibility with other versions has not been verified. Extract the entire ZIP into a new folder, then run `ModEngine/launchmod_eldenring.bat`. Do not layer older tests or patches over this package. See [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) for details.

The supplied profile starts offline. Back up saves before testing an overhaul. No Windows game session was run when preparing this release; archive, resource, configuration, and checksum checks do not certify gameplay.

## Project status

The project grew from an Ascended-based development branch. This beta retains that historical basis plus subsequent NIGHTTIDE integrations; the planned migration to a clean independent foundation is still pending. It is not an official continuation of Ascended and is not affiliated with FromSoftware, Bandai Namco, or third-party mod authors.

NIGHTTIDE is a non-commercial fan project. Attribution is recorded in [CREDITS.md](CREDITS.md); inclusion does not transfer ownership of game or third-party assets.

Report the version, arena, boss phase, reproduction steps, and a short video where possible in [Issues](https://github.com/TrasAsimov/ELDEN-RING-NIGHTTIDE/issues). Please distinguish repeatable problems from one-time observations.
